title: wacli: latest messages of one chat (#360)
description: Print the 15 latest messages of one WhatsApp chat from the local wacli store, oldest first, one JSON object per line: msgId, text (first 500 characters), fromMe, sender, chatJid, at. Reactions are left out. Needs wacli (kept live by `wacli sync --follow`) and jq. Exits non-zero when wacli fails, so the poll is retried and never records an empty baseline. Used by the poll trigger of examples/workflows/wacli-mention.yaml.
command: out=$(wacli messages list --chat <CHAT_JID> --limit 15 --json) || exit 1; printf '%s\n' "$out" | jq -c '(.data.messages // .data // .) | reverse | .[] | select((.ReactionToID // "") == "") | {msgId: .MsgID, text: ((.Text // "")[0:500]), fromMe: .FromMe, sender: .SenderName, chatJid: .ChatJID, at: .Timestamp}'
